notes: RGB + no longer paints colours that have nothing to do with the theme you picked. Its glow overlays were sweeping the whole hue wheel while the app’s own accents stayed the flat pink and blue the theme defines, and because the two glow colours sit 120° apart, that sweep walked through clashing pairs: a green edge beside a red one, a yellow edge beside a magenta one, all on top of a pink and blue app. The glow now swings between the theme’s two accents and through the violet between them, so at every moment the edges are the theme’s own colours or a blend of the two → it opens on the exact pink and blue the theme defines, meets in the middle of the cycle, and comes back

The glow still animates and still pumps with the bass. Only the range of colours it travels through changed, and it now runs at the theme’s full strength instead of a washed-out version of it, so on the pink and blue theme it opens identical to the static accents
Nothing changed for plain RGB (animated), which is meant to cycle every colour, or for any other theme’s glow.
